baseline: The owner's two hand captures on 0.5.1-rc1 (captures/owner-halo-1016/logcat-nova-full.txt pid 24554, logcat-nova-2154.txt pid 30514), read with docs/lanes/halo1016/timeline.py: ~1.5 min at 29-30 gfps, then a plateau 21:25:03-21:25:52 (pid 24554) at 8-14 gfps in its core, G 66-117 ms/frame, 13-19 gfps at its edges; recovery to 29 for ~8 s; a second slow stretch from 21:26:01 (6 gfps, still slow at the capture's end). In the plateau core: guest idle 40-50 % of each 2-s window ([rr425w] idle_us/(idle_us+busy_us)), every busy span begun by the NV2A wake 33.44, the PFIFO thread on CPU 44-48 % of wall ([rdc] tcpu/dt, ~48 ms per frame at ~1000 draws), fifoskew drain=0 with a 120-230 KB backlog. At the edges: guest idle 0, FLDCW TB ends (rr425pc e:01ec3a) 10-20x baseline. No frametrace or probe1010 reading of this scene exists.
prediction: #1018: what the PFIFO thread does with the half of the plateau it is off CPU, and whether the GPU's GMEM binning is on the path. A is master's code with frametrace and the PFIFO wait probe on; B adds TU_DEBUG=sysmem (Turnip renders once instead of once per GMEM tile; the per-title table already does this for AUF, DOA and NFS MW). Hypotheses and the leg that reads each: F1 the GPU is on the path (the heavy shot's ~1000 draws replayed per tile): G and P. F2 synchronous finishes mid-frame (surface downloads, vertex or staging buffer full) wait out the GPU: W. F3 the PFIFO thread's own CPU per draw: S's p_run. F5 lock waits on the PFIFO thread: S's lock share. F6 run-queue delay: S's rq share. Predicted on A, frames ending inside the plateau span (pace windows of ms/frame >= 50 between mark+40 s and mark+260 s): S: the PFIFO thread's p_run is 35-60 ms/frame and its blocked time is >= 30 % of the period, of which waits on the GPU (fence, submit, rthr and the unhooked finish_event remainder) are >= 60 %, lock waits (bql, pfl, pgl) <= 15 %, and p_rq <= 10 % of the period. G: frametrace gpu50 over those frames is >= 0.5 x the period (raw timestamps; the Nova's timestampPeriod reads 1.573x fast per flip474, so a raw 0.5 is ~0.8 true). W: probe1010's non-deferred finishes are >= 1.5 per frame in the span. P (sysmem, the remedy leg): B's mean period over A's plateau span (same seconds after mark cinematic) <= 0.80 x A's; point 0.70. P(P hits) 0.35. What refutes F1: G under 0.3 x period and P above 0.95; then the off-CPU half is F2/F5/F6 and S names which. The speech (#938) is not judged here: these builds carry no meter.
